_source.mechanics: FG&G p.69 (printed 59): a saving throw is 1d20 + applicable modifiers, succeeding on equal-or-exceed the class/level score; saves are instinctive — awareness of the danger is not required
_source.rules_page: FG&G p.70 (printed 60): category definitions, priority order, creature mapping, voluntary failure, ability-checks-as-saves, modifier law (bonuses/penalties move the DIE, not the required score; GM situational range -4..+4)

priority.rule: When an effect straddles categories, the save is chosen by priority running from paralyzation/poison/death (highest) down to spell (lowest) — poison delivered from a wand saves vs. poison, not vs. wand. Spell is also the catch-all for effects with no definite classification. (FG&G p.70)

creatures.rule: Creatures and NPCs without ability scores take the warrior progression keyed to their Hit Dice; a creature that casts wizard or priest spells uses that caster's progression instead, and one with thief abilities uses the rogue's. (FG&G p.70)
creatures.hd_mapping: Hit Dice stand in for warrior level on Table 3.2; fractional and sub-1 HD land on the lowest (1-2) row — the table prints no lower bracket
creatures.plus_bump: An HD bonus of +3 or more counts the creature one Hit Die greater for THACO AND saving throws (FG&G p.309) — the same effective-HD law the thac0_2e table applies

modifiers.rule: Bonuses and penalties modify the DIE ROLL, never the required score. Witnessed sources (FG&G p.70): high wisdom vs. mental effects; exceptional constitution vs. poison; high dexterity vs. dodgeable effects; magical items per description; magical armor's enchantment bonus vs. externally-damaging effects only (no help vs. gas, poison, or mental attacks); per-spell/per-poison modifiers; GM situational calls in the -4..+4 band
modifiers.voluntary_failure: A character may consciously choose to fail a save — it must be clearly declared, and the effect then works as normal (FG&G p.70)
modifiers.ability_checks: Where an ability score could avert the harm, an ability check replaces the save (FG&G p.70)
